answer.rationale: Primary objective forbids raising delivery risk. The line is at 94% with no buffer and the contract ends in 14 days without auto-renewal, so switching primary or letting supply lapse would put downstream assembly at risk even if the low-cost quote hits the 18% cut. memory_c1 supports keeping the incumbent for integration and delivery continuity. memory_c4 is the path that can pursue spend reduction at renewal without a vendor change. memory_c2’s past switch looks attractive on unit cost but is not assumed transferable to a zero-buffer, two-week cutover. Verifying c2 and c4 to test whether prior onboarding was actually low-risk in comparable conditions and whether renegotiation ever moved price near an 18% cut. Uncertain the incumbent can meet the mandate; that uncertainty is preserved rather than assumed away.
